name: bld4_tripotent_trace_eq_rank_sub_rank
statement: (K : Type*) [Field K] [CharZero K] (ι : Type*) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι K) (hA : A * A * A = A) : A.trace = ((A * A + A).rank : K) - ((A * A - A).rank : K)
closed: ∀ (K : Type*) [Field K] [CharZero K] (ι : Type*) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι K) (hA : A * A * A = A), A.trace = ((A * A + A).rank : K) - ((A * A - A).rank : K)
informal: Uses Mathlib2.gen_lin_idempotent_trace_eq_rank_field and Mathlib2.lib_matrix_rank_smul: P = (1/2)(A^2 + A) and Q = (1/2)(A^2 − A) are idempotent when A^3 = A, and A = P − Q. So tr A = tr P − tr Q = rank P − rank Q by gen_lin_idempotent_trace_eq_rank_field, and lib_matrix_rank_smul removes the scalar 1/2 from the ranks.
type: ∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K] [CharZero K] (ι : Type u_2) [inst_2 : Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι K), A * A * A = A → A.trace = ↑(A * A + A).rank - ↑(A * A - A).rank
